delta: P27 B7a: freeze the DSH session-log record decoder, DSH/durable-event to BotRow mapping, rowID and entrySeq formula, surfaceOp append/replace handling, tombstone and cursor semantics, watch(after:), epoch chains and the 10/s streaming limiter (PC-20261112-android-bot-w4).

Input cases carry raw DSH JSONL records (including v4 headers when relevant) and durable BotEvent objects; expected rows are the exact JSON the Swift BotRow encodes, with origins/display/chatActionNonces kept beside the row so the Python validator can re-check ids, entrySeq and the display composition.

history.cases freeze rebuild/reset/watch/reconcile batches, late appends and the no-resurrection rule; streaming.cases freeze immediate emission, coalescing, the rolling one-second window and nextFlushAt.
invalidRecords freeze skipped-record diagnostics: non-canonical surfaceOp, missing data, broken JSON, a v3 header and a misplaced header. Unknown types are skipped without diagnostics.
